subject: website
name: Eternal Safe
summary: Eternal Safe, a decentralised fork of the Safe{Wallet} interface, open source (GPL-3.0). It makes no request when it opens and runs no third-party code, which is Level 3. It is not Level 4: once a network is chosen, Safe accounts are read through public RPC endpoints (Infura, Ankr and others) by default, without a light client. A custom endpoint can be set.
